title: Vector Addition and Subtraction in 3D
body: Given $$\vec{A}=(3.00\hat{i}-4.00\hat{j}+4.00\hat{k})\,\text{m}$$ and $$\vec{B}=(2.00\hat{i}+3.00\hat{j}-7.00\hat{k})\,\text{m},$$ find the displacement vectors and their magnitudes for (a) $$\vec{C}=\vec{A}+\vec{B}$$ and (b) $$\vec{D}=2\vec{A}-\vec{B}$$.
